pages.text: This mod adds 4 small berry bushes, never taller than one block.$(br2)Plant on suitable soil and climate. Growth uses TFC settings; right-click when fruiting, then wait for bloom cooldown. Sharp tools recover main bushes (young spreading bushes may fail); canes drop sticks. Seasons shift in the south. Look for wild bushes in newly generated chunks.

pages.title: Small Bush Calendar
pages.text: The fruiting calendar of the 4 small bushes.

pages.title: Lingonberry
pages.text: Can be found in regions with: $(br)$(bold)$(l:tfc:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)Temperature$(): -18°C - 16°C$(br)$(bold)Groundwater$(): 100 - 300mm$(br)$(bold)Forest coverage$(): 2 - 4$(br2)As a crop it needs $(bold)hydration$() 25 - 75 %.$(br2)Form: $(thing)small$() — a low lying bush, never taller than one block.$(br2)Lingonberry grows from April to June, flowers in July, and bears fruit in August and September. It can be found in cold, damp forests.
